blocks.title: Photoelectric effect
blocks.text: Jab suitable (munasib) frequency ya wavelength ki roshni kisi metal ki surface (satah) par parti hai aur us se electrons nikalte hain, to is process (amal) ko photoelectric effect kehte hain. Nikalne wale electrons ko photoelectrons kehte hain.

Fig. 18.1 ka apparatus yeh effect dikhata hai. Ek evacuated (hawa nikali hui) sheeshe ki tube X mein do electrodes hain. Battery ke positive terminal se juda electrode anode (A) hai, aur negative terminal se juda metal electrode C cathode hai. Jab munasib frequency ki monochromatic (ek rang ki) roshni cathode par parti hai to us se electrons nikalne lagte hain. Positive anode in photoelectrons ko apni taraf kheenchta hai aur jo current banta hai use micro-ammeter napta hai. Roshni band karein to current ruk jata hai; is se sabit hota hai ke current roshni ki wajah se hai. Is liye ise photoelectric current kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Incident (aane wali) roshni colour filter (rang chhanne wala filter) se guzar kar photocell X par parti hai, jis mein cathode C aur anode A hain. Micro-ammeter A cell ke saath series mein, voltmeter V us ke across (aar paar), aur cell potential divider Y ke sliding contact (sarakne wala contact) se battery se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.1: photoelectric effect dekhne ka experimental arrangement (tajurbe ka intizam) (kitab ki Figure 18.1 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is paragraph mein anode ko 'electrode B' likhti hai, lekin Fig. 18.1 aur agla paragraph use A (anode A) kehte hain. Sahi naam anode A hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Roshni filter se aik rang ki ho kar cathode C par parti aur electrons nikalte hain jo anode A tak ja kar current banate hain; micro-ammeter A yeh current napta aur voltmeter V cell ka voltage. Slider Y ko sarkane se voltage kam ziyada hota hai. Kitab ki shakal mein cell ka daayan taar potential divider se jura hi nahi (circuit adhoora hai); hum ne ise divider ke daayen sire se jor diya hai, warna koi current nahi chal sakta.

Photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada (maximum) energy maloom karne ke liye battery ke connections ulat diye jate hain: ab anode A negative aur cathode C positive potential par hai. Anode ab photoelectrons ko peeche dhakelta (repel karta) hai, is liye current kam ho jata hai. Agar yeh potential aur zyada negative karte jayen to ek khaas value par current bilkul zero ho jata hai. Is value ko stopping potential V₀ kehte hain. Is par sab se zyada energy wale electrons bhi collector plate tak nahi pohanch pate. Is liye photoelectrons ki maximum kinetic energy:

Yahan m electron ka mass, v us ki velocity aur e electron ka charge hai. Agar zyada intensity (tez) roshni se experiment (tajurba) dobara karein to current barh jata hai, lekin current usi V₀ par rukta hai. Fig. 18.2 mein potential V ke saath photoelectric current ke do curves hain, jahan I₂ > I₁.

blocks.alt: Photocurrent Ip aur lagaye gaye voltage (-V se +V) ka graph. Do curves, I2 oopar aur I1 neeche (I2 > I1), dono negative side par aik hi stopping potential Vo par zero current se shuru hote hain aur alag alag saturation currents par seedhe (flat) ho jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.2: monochromatic (aik rang ki) roshni ki do intensities ke liye photocurrent aur voltage ke characteristic curves (kitab ki Figure 18.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Ab intensity ek jaisi rakh kar alag alag frequencies ki roshni se experiment karein to Fig. 18.3 jaise curves milte hain. Current wahi rehta hai lekin har frequency ka stopping potential alag hota hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke maximum kinetic energy roshni ki frequency f par depend karti hai (frequency barhe to yeh bhi barhti hai).

blocks.alt: Photocurrent Ip aur voltage ka graph. Frequency f2 ka curve f1 ke curve se zyada negative voltage par zero se shuru hota hai (f2 > f1); dono oopar uth kar positive voltage par aik hi saturation current par mil jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.3: alag alag frequencies ki roshni ke liye photocurrent aur voltage ke characteristic curves (kitab ki Figure 18.3 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke maximum K.E. frequency ke proportional hai. (K.E.)max = hf − hf₀ frequency ke saath seedhi line mein (linearly) barhti hai, magar proportional nahi: yeh f₀ par zero hoti hai, f = 0 par nahi.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Fig 18.2 mein roshni tez karne se current barhta hai (I2 > I1) lekin dono curves aik hi Vo par zero hote hain: intensity electrons ki tadaad (number) barhati hai, un ki maximum energy nahi. Fig 18.3 mein frequency barhane (f2 > f1) se stopping potential barh jata hai, yani zyada frequency par electrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy zyada hoti hai.
(K.E.)max aur roshni ki frequency ke graph se experiment ke yeh ahem results (nataij) milte hain:

items: Electrons alag alag energies ke saath nikalte hain. Photoelectrons ki maximum energy metal ki qisam aur roshni ki frequency par depend karti hai.

Ek kam se kam frequency hoti hai jise threshold frequency kehte hain; is se kam frequency par koi electron nahi nikalta, roshni chahe kitni hi tez ho. Maslan neeli (blue) roshni sodium metal se electrons nikalti hai lekin laal (red) roshni nahi (Fig. 18.4). Threshold frequency f₀ har metal ki alag hoti hai. Is se judi wavelength ko threshold wavelength kehte hain.
Electrons foran (instantaneously) nikalte hain; roshni ki intensity sirf un ki tadaad (number) tay karti hai.

blocks.alt: Do lehrati (wavy) light rays. Lambi wavelength wali red (laal) ray, 'Red light (low intensity)', 'No electron emitted' par khatam hoti hai. Chhoti wavelength wali blue (neeli) ray, 'Blue light (high intensity)', 'Electron emitted (more electrons)' par khatam hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.4: sodium metal par red aur blue roshni (kitab ki Figure 18.4 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Roshni ki electromagnetic wave theory in results ki explanation (wazahat) nahi de saki. Is theory ke mutabiq roshni ki intensity barhane se nikalne wale electrons ki K.E. barhni chahiye thi, jo experiment ke result ke khilaf hai. Classical theory threshold frequency ki bhi explanation nahi de sakti.
Isi theory ke mutabiq kam energy wali roshni bhi kuch der baad electrons ko azad karne ke liye kafi energy de deti. Lekin aisa nahi hota.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab red roshni ko 'low intensity' aur blue ko 'high intensity' likhti hai, lekin asal baat intensity nahi, frequency hai: red roshni kitni hi tez kyun na ho, sodium se electron nahi nikalti, kyunke us ki frequency threshold frequency fo se kam hai; blue roshni dheemi ho tab bhi electrons nikalti hai.
